context_requirements: Expression of the targeted SLC transporter or channel in the assayed cell line
Dependence on the transported solute for a transcriptional program that can be measured in 6-24 h
A drug concentration sufficient to inhibit the transporter at 10 micromolar
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes in SLC7A11, SLC2A1, SLC1A4 or other SLC-family landmark genes consistent with direct transporter inhibition
